title: Signature Lake Country Wine Tour
includes: Traveller pickup is offered. We pick up at most hotels, B&Bs, Vacation Rentals, Airbnb, Campgrounds.
Public transportation (bus, subway, cable car, etc.)
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore Lake Country wine country with a route built around estate wineries, vineyard views, and efficient appointment timing. Your tour visits 4 selected wineries from the region based on availability, group size, and driving flow.

Kelowna Wine & Adventure Tours offers a fun and memorable day of wine tasting in Lake Country. On your Wine tour you will receive complimentary hotel pick up and drop off in one of our comfortable, clean, reliable, and air-conditioned vehicles. We stop and sip spectacular wines at some of the Valley’s award-winning wineries. Our tours can be customized from a romantic private tour for two, to large corporate events. 

Your tour includes 4 selected wineries from this region. The wineries below are the regional pool we can plan from for this tasting tier; the final route depends on the date, tasting appointments, group size, and drive timing.

Ancient Hill Estate Winery
Arrowleaf Cellars
Blind Tiger Vineyards
Upside Cidery
Intrigue Wines
